name: stock_download
description: Signed download URL for a stock item. Pass folder_reference to also save as a creation (not for 3d). type=3d converts to GLB asynchronously: `status` is `processing` with `retryAfterSeconds` until it is `ready`; repeat the same call.

folder_reference.description: Project folder UUID. When provided, creation saved to library. Ignored for 3d.

format.description: Default: render (flattened image). vector/psd only: source = layered PSD/vector ZIP for editors. icon only: png = 512px raster instead of the SVG.

max_bytes.description: video only: largest file the caller can place, in bytes. Picks the best MP4 rendition under it instead of the largest; when none fits, the smallest one.

type.description: Default: photo. Use "icon" for SVG, "3d" for a GLB (async, poll on status=processing).
